## What's new

- **Liquid glass.** On iOS 26 Kultr uses the system's own liquid glass tab bar: touch it and a clear lens follows your finger between the tabs, search has its own round button beside it, and the bar shrinks out of the way while you scroll. The mini player rides on the tab bar, and download progress floats above it as another piece of glass. On iOS 17 to 18, Kultr draws a floating glass bar that behaves the same way.
- **Feels like an iPhone app.** Every tab keeps its own pages with iOS's navigation bar and swipe-back; search is iOS's search field; Settings is a list of pages with native switches, pickers and sliders; album, artist and playlist pages have large artwork with Play and Shuffle side by side.
- **Long-press anything** — a track, album, artist or playlist — for a menu to play it next, add it to the queue, favourite, download or remove it. Swipe a track right to play it next, left to add it to the queue. Choose **Select** in the menu to pick several tracks at once.
- **Swipe between Library tabs.** Albums, artists, songs, playlists, genres, favourites, downloads and radio are pages you can swipe through; the underline follows your finger, and each page keeps its own filter. The Songs page scrolls smoothly through libraries of any size.
- **Your listening lives on your server.** Every play is sent to Navidrome with the time it happened. Plays made offline go later, exactly once, and a play for a track that was deleted no longer holds up the rest. Plays from your other devices come back too, when you check for updates and whenever you open the app.
- **Jump back in and the Listening page** are built on your server's numbers, so they are the same on every device: played recently, played the most, top artists, a refresh button (or pull down), and how many plays are still waiting to be sent. The setting is now called **Send plays to Navidrome**.
- **InjeKt plans as soon as a track starts,** so the planner has the whole track to choose a mix point from and the plan shows straight away. The next track is only loaded about 30 seconds before the mix. **Analyse ahead** now looks one track further.
- **Pick up where you left off.** Pressing play on headphones or in Control Center with nothing loaded resumes the last queue where it stopped.
- **Motion that goes both ways,** with haptics: highlights slide, rows move, the selection bar animates in and out. **Reduce motion** (in Kultr or in iOS's Accessibility settings) turns these off.
- Pull down on Home or Sync to check for changes on the server.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux). New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kultr_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
